base.label: Home base: Golf Sud, Parcelles, Cambérène

meta.driveNote: **Drive times.** All times "from base" are **researcher estimates** by geography from Golf Sud (Guédiawaye), Parcelles Assainies and Cambérène for off-peak driving; add 50 to 100 percent at rush hour, roughly 7:00 to 9:30 and 17:00 to 20:00. The estimate bands used throughout are: CICES, Zone de Captage and Yoff 10 to 25 minutes; Hann 15 to 40 minutes; Ngor and the Almadies 20 to 35 minutes; Ouakam, Mamelles, Point E and Mermoz 25 to 40 minutes; Fann and the Corniche Ouest 30 to 50 minutes; Plateau and Corniche Est 35 to 75 minutes; Lac Rose 40 to 60 minutes; Kayar 1 h 15 to 1 h 45. Times quoted as "sourced" come from a named page and usually start from central Dakar.

sections.title: Family food, cafés, ice cream and pool day passes
Kids: zoos, reserves, parks, play centres and events

entries.name: Chez Loutcha
fields: Cape Verdean and Senegalese institution (thiéboudiène, yassa, mafé), named in more independent lists than any other Senegalese restaurant and "the first place that comes to mind" for locals asked about thiéboudiène; the thiéboudiène is "enough for three".
Monday to Saturday 12:00 to 15:30 and 19:30 to 22:00, closed Sunday, per a third-party guide, not confirmed by the restaurant; arrive before midday, it is busy and no-frills.
Large portions, family-run, indoor city room with no sea edge; high chairs not documented.

sum.en: Cape Verdean and Senegalese institution for thiéboudiène, yassa and mafé, with portions big enough to share. 7,000 to 12,000 FCFA; closed Sunday, arrive before midday.
sum.fr: Institution capverdienne et sénégalaise pour thiéboudiène, yassa et mafé, aux portions à partager. 7 000 à 12 000 FCFA; fermé le dimanche, arrivez avant midi.

entries.name: Le Lagon 1
entries.area: Route de la Corniche Est, Plateau; on stilts over the sea facing Gorée.
fields: Seafood and French institution, "impeccable service", suited to special occasions; about 1,000 Tripadvisor reviews at 4.2, top of the city's fine-dining filter.
Dishes from 15,000 FCFA (about CAD 32); "the bill can quickly get salty". Its private beach cost 3,000 FCFA (about CAD 6) on weekdays in 2024.
Seaside pontoon and paid private beach popular with expats; SEA-EDGE caution, no information on railings.

sum.en: Seafood and French restaurant on stilts over the sea facing Gorée, with impeccable service: a special-occasion pick. Dishes from 15,000 FCFA; hours conflict (opens 12:00 or 10:00). Sea edge, watch toddlers.
sum.fr: Restaurant de poissons et cuisine française sur pilotis face à Gorée, au service impeccable: pour une occasion spéciale. Plats dès 15 000 FCFA; horaires contradictoires (12:00 ou 10:00). Bord de mer, surveillez les petits.

entries.name: La Fourchette
fields: French and international fusion institution; live singer on Thursday evenings; 4.6 from 307 reviews.
25,000 to 40,000 FCFA (about CAD 53 to 85) per Dakar Town; SénéGuide average 30,000 (about CAD 64).
Opens 12:00 (day of consultation; full week not shown).
Chic, refined setting for romantic or special-occasion dinners; likely less suited to toddlers (inference).

sum.en: French and international fusion, chic and refined: a romantic or special-occasion dinner for a couple, probably less suited to toddlers. Live singer on Thursday evenings; opens 12:00.
sum.fr: Cuisine fusion française et internationale, chic et raffinée: un dîner romantique ou une occasion spéciale en couple, sans doute moins adapté aux tout-petits. Chanteur en direct le jeudi soir; ouvre à 12:00.

entries.name: Le Kermel
fields: French brasserie (mashed potatoes, egg cocottes); 4.9 from 47 reviews.
Opens 09:00; lunch service can be slow.
Reviewers describe a "family, warm atmosphere"; early opening helps; slow lunches do not.

sum.en: French brasserie with a family, warm atmosphere, mashed potatoes and egg cocottes. Opens 09:00, which helps with little ones; lunch formula about 8,500 FCFA, but lunch service can be slow.
sum.fr: Brasserie française à l'ambiance familiale et chaleureuse, avec purée et cocottes d'œufs. Ouvre à 09:00, pratique avec des petits; formule midi d'environ 8 500 FCFA, mais le service du déjeuner peut être lent.

entries.name: Le Dagorne
entries.area: CONFLICT, possibly moved: Plateau next to Kermel ([Jean-Michel Voyage, May 2025](https://www.jeanmichelvoyage.com/en/the-best-restaurants-or-eat-a-dakar/)) versus Mermoz-Sacré-Cœur ([SénéGuide 2026](https://www.seneguide.com/restaurants/dakar)).

sum.en: Chic French restaurant rated 4.6 from 36 reviews, a dinner option for a couple. Dishes from 10,000 FCFA, average 18,000; opens 12:00. The source flags a conflict on its location, so confirm.
sum.fr: Restaurant français chic, noté 4.6 sur 36 avis, une option pour un dîner à deux. Plats dès 10 000 FCFA, moyenne de 18 000; ouvre à 12:00. Adresse contradictoire dans les sources, à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Bideew (also spelled Bidew)
entries.area: Plateau, inside the Institut français, 89 Rue Joseph Gomis.
fields: French-Senegalese café-restaurant with Senegalese specialities, a Saturday lunchtime all-you-can-eat buffet, draught beer and DJ sets; 4.4 from 42 reviews; in Dakar Town's Senegalese top 10.
"Very good value"; exact figure not found.

Colourful garden; the Institut français garden has a big tree and lizards. A strong daytime choice: enclosed cultural-centre garden, no sea edge (inference), and it pairs with the Médiathèque's toddler workshops (Section 3).

sum.en: French-Senegalese café-restaurant with a colourful garden, a Saturday lunchtime buffet and draught beer. A strong daytime pick for families, and it pairs with the Médiathèque's toddler workshops. Opens 10:00.
sum.fr: Café-restaurant franco-sénégalais avec jardin coloré, buffet à volonté le samedi midi et bière pression. Un bon choix de jour en famille, à combiner avec les ateliers pour tout-petits de la Médiathèque. Ouvre à 10:00.

entries.name: Restaurant Farid / Terrasse Farid
entries.area: Plateau, next to the Institut français.
fields: Lebanese (mezze, hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush, grilled meat and fish), vegetarian and vegan options; Lonely Planet calls it the best Lebanese mezze in the city; 4.6 from 137 reviews.
Pleasant terrace; slow service is the drawback with toddlers.

sum.en: Lebanese mezze, grills and vegetarian options on a pleasant terrace, called the city's best by Lonely Planet. Average 17,000 FCFA; opens 12:00, but slow service is the drawback with toddlers.
sum.fr: Mezzés libanais, grillades et options végétariennes sur une terrasse agréable, élu meilleur du genre en ville par Lonely Planet. Moyenne de 17 000 FCFA; ouvre à 12:00, mais le service lent pèse avec des tout-petits.

entries.name: Sekubi
entries.area: Plateau, next to Place de l'Indépendance.
fields: Gourmet Italian with a weekly-changing menu; quiet, sea view and garden.
Lunch formula 10,000 FCFA (about CAD 21) for starter, main and dessert.
Garden plus fast service makes it one of the better Plateau lunches with toddlers (inference).

sum.en: Gourmet Italian with a weekly-changing menu, a quiet sea view and a garden: one of the better Plateau lunches with toddlers. Lunch formula 10,000 FCFA for starter, main and dessert; single source, confirm.
sum.fr: Italien gastronomique au menu changeant chaque semaine, calme, avec vue sur la mer et jardin: l'un des meilleurs déjeuners du Plateau avec des tout-petits. Formule midi à 10 000 FCFA; source unique, à confirmer.

entries.name: Pullman Dakar Teranga: Teranga Beach Club and Teranga Lounge
fields: Hotel restaurants; the Teranga Beach Club serves "creative", Mediterranean-inspired food by Chef Hayat Laghrib on the beach; Tripadvisor 4.8. Wikipedia lists Pierre Thiam as the Pullman's Signature Chef since 2015; current involvement not verified.
Not found for regular meals; festive prices in Section 2.
dakar.reservations@accor.com; 78 631 82 82 was the number for its 2025 holiday events.

A reviewer calls it an excellent family experience; it also hosts Dakar Fashion Week's young designers' show on Fri Dec 4 and closing brunch on Sun Dec 6, 2026, per the earlier events research ([dakarfashionweek.com](https://dakarfashionweek.com)), so expect crowds those days.

sum.en: Pullman hotel restaurants, with the Teranga Beach Club serving creative Mediterranean-inspired food on the beach. A reviewer calls it an excellent family experience; regular prices not found.
sum.fr: Restaurants de l'hôtel Pullman, dont le Teranga Beach Club, cuisine créative d'inspiration méditerranéenne sur la plage. Un avis le décrit comme une excellente expérience en famille; prix courants non trouvés.

sum.en: Argentine grill rated 4.7 from 310 reviews, a dinner for a couple or one adult, not a toddler outing. Average 32,000 FCFA; opens 19:30, dinner only. Single source, confirm.
sum.fr: Grill argentin noté 4.7 sur 310 avis, un dîner pour un couple ou un adulte, pas une sortie avec des tout-petits. Moyenne de 32 000 FCFA; ouvre à 19:30, dîner seulement. Source unique, à confirmer.

sum.en: Italian restaurant rated 4.6 from 80 reviews, for an evening out as a couple. Average 30,000 FCFA; opens 19:00, dinner only, so not a toddler lunch. To confirm.
sum.fr: Restaurant italien noté 4.6 sur 80 avis, pour une soirée en couple. Moyenne de 30 000 FCFA; ouvre à 19:00, dîner seulement, donc pas pour un déjeuner avec des tout-petits. À confirmer.

entries.name: Dakytori
fields: Japanese-Peruvian sushi; called the best sushi in town

sum.en: Japanese-Peruvian sushi, called the best sushi in town: a treat for a couple or one adult. Average 14,000 FCFA; opens 12:00. Toddler suitability not documented.
sum.fr: Sushis japonais-péruviens, présentés comme les meilleurs de la ville: un plaisir pour un couple ou un adulte. Moyenne de 14 000 FCFA; ouvre à 12:00. Adaptation aux tout-petits non documentée.

sum.en: Asian restaurant whose cuisine is in conflict: sources say Vietnamese or Chinese. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before planning a visit.
sum.fr: Restaurant asiatique dont la cuisine est contradictoire: les sources disent vietnamienne ou chinoise. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant de prévoir une visite.

sum.en: Saint-Louis-style Senegalese cooking, with thiéré mboum, described as authentic, simple but warm: a relaxed local meal for a family. Single source; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Cuisine sénégalaise façon Saint-Louis, avec du thiéré mboum, décrite comme authentique, simple mais chaleureuse: un repas local détendu en famille. Source unique; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Le Restaurant du Centre
fields: Senegalese, family meals and business lunches
Described as suited to family meals

sum.en: Senegalese restaurant described as suited to family meals, also used for business lunches: a simple local option for the family. Single source; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Restaurant sénégalais décrit comme adapté aux repas de famille, aussi prisé pour les déjeuners d'affaires: une option locale simple pour la famille. Source unique; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: The Seoul
fields: Courtyard pool is a toddler hazard (inference)

sum.en: Korean BBQ and bibimbap, described as good value, a change from local food for a couple or one adult. The courtyard pool is a toddler hazard. Single source; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Barbecue coréen et bibimbap, décrits comme d'un bon rapport qualité-prix, pour changer de la cuisine locale à deux ou seul. La piscine de la cour est un danger pour les tout-petits. Source unique; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Le Diotay
fields: Sunset apéritif, salmon tartare, sole meunière; 4.0 from 31

sum.en: Sunset apéritif spot with salmon tartare and sole meunière, rated 4.0 from 31 reviews: one for a couple. Prices, hours and toddler notes not found, so confirm first.
sum.fr: Adresse d'apéritif au coucher du soleil, avec tartare de saumon et sole meunière, notée 4.0 sur 31 avis: plutôt pour un couple. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: Union Amicale Corse
fields: Drinks and pétanque with a sea view

sum.en: Drinks and pétanque with a sea view, a relaxed spot for a couple or one adult. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Boissons et pétanque avec vue sur la mer, une adresse décontractée pour un couple ou un adulte seul. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Japanese restaurant where booking is recommended, an option for a couple's dinner. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant japonais où la réservation est recommandée, une option pour un dîner à deux. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Japanese-Korean sushi restaurant, an easy change of cuisine for a couple or one adult. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant de sushis japonais-coréen, pour changer de cuisine à deux ou seul. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

entries.name: L'Orientale
fields: Lebanese grills, pizzas, burgers; can be noisy

sum.en: Lebanese grills, pizzas and burgers, an easy menu for a family, but it can be noisy. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Grillades libanaises, pizzas et burgers, un menu facile pour une famille, mais l'endroit peut être bruyant. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Cheap, casual Lebanese restaurant, a low-cost meal option for the family or one adult. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant libanais bon marché et décontracté, un repas économique pour la famille ou un adulte seul. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Restaurant serving Chinese, Thai and Vietnamese dishes, a varied Asian choice for a couple or one adult. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm first.
sum.fr: Restaurant proposant des plats chinois, thaïlandais et vietnamiens, un choix asiatique varié pour un couple ou un adulte seul. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: La Terrasse du Terrou-Bi
entries.area: Boulevard Martin Luther King, Corniche Ouest, in the Terrou-Bi hotel.
fields: Senegalese seafood brasserie with an ocean view: grouper, grilled octopus, cuttlefish, gambas or spiny lobster depending on the catch, and always an African main at weekday lunch; 4.5 from 577 reviews. The page says it reopened "in May" after renovation, year not stated.

Weekday lunch menu 19,000 FCFA for 2 courses or 23,000 for 3, water and coffee included (about CAD 40 / 49); SénéGuide average 26,000 (55); Dakar Town puts Terrou-Bi fine dining at 40,000 to 50,000 (85 to 106). Sunday "Dimanche Gourmand" brunch prices in Section 2.
Weekday lunch Monday to Friday; Sunday brunch 12:30 to 16:30; opens 12:30.
Families gather at the Sunday brunch, which includes pool access; the hotel has the city's only confirmed children's pool (Section 2). No kids' menu information.

sum.en: Senegalese seafood brasserie with an ocean view; families gather at its Sunday brunch, which includes pool access. Weekday lunch menu 19,000 FCFA for 2 courses or 23,000 for 3. No kids' menu information.
sum.fr: Brasserie sénégalaise de fruits de mer avec vue sur l'océan; les familles se retrouvent au brunch du dimanche, piscine incluse. Menu midi en semaine à 19 000 FCFA pour 2 plats ou 23 000 pour 3.

entries.name: L'Avenue, Noom Hotel Dakar Sea Plaza (formerly Radisson Blu Dakar Sea Plaza)
entries.area: Corniche Ouest, beside the Sea Plaza mall.
fields: Hotel restaurant serving Senegalese "traditional revisited". RENAMED: the hotel's restaurant page now sits under "radisson-individuals-noom-dakar-sea-plaza", Hotels.com titles the property "Noom Hotel Dakar Sea Plaza, a member of Radisson Individuals" on the old Radisson Blu URL, and the Noom phone in the 2025 holiday guide matches the 2016 Radisson Blu number.

Not found. The Sunday brunch was called the city's most extensive and most expensive (undated). Older brunch figures: 25,000 adult, 12,000 for ages 4 to 12, free under 4, with pool access and toddlers making their own pizza (blog, 2021 to 2023, unconfirmed); 30,000 adult, 11,000 for 7 to 12, free under 7 in 2016. A SénéGuide weekly listing page titled "super brunch au Noom" was updated Nov 14, 2026; its current price was not captured.
Infinity pool; historically a family brunch with pool. Little Buddha, the nightspot once reached through the hotel gardens, shows no event after October 2017 and is treated as likely closed.

sum.en: Hotel restaurant serving Senegalese cuisine revisited, with an infinity pool and a historically family-friendly Sunday brunch. Renamed from Radisson Blu; confirm brunch details and prices.
sum.fr: Restaurant d'hôtel de cuisine sénégalaise revisitée, avec piscine à débordement et un brunch du dimanche historiquement familial. Anciennement Radisson Blu, rebaptisé; brunch et prix à confirmer.

entries.name: Soumbédioune beach fish grills
entries.area: Corniche Ouest, by the fish market and pirogue landing.
fields: After sunset the beach fills with open-air tables serving grilled fish with fries, sauce and salad or rice, with drummers. One named venue: Espace Poisson, 4.0 from about 230 reviews, "open 24 hours" per a third-party page (unverified).
Not found; fish prices have risen sharply.
Evening, crowded, on a beach that is polluted by canal discharges and officially forbidden for swimming; an adventurous early dinner at most, not a relaxed toddler meal (inference).

sum.en: After sunset the beach fills with open-air tables serving grilled fish with drummers: a lively scene, but crowded and not a relaxed toddler meal. Evenings only; fish prices have risen.
sum.fr: Après le coucher du soleil, la plage se garnit de tables en plein air servant du poisson grillé, avec des tambours: une scène animée, mais bondée et peu adaptée aux tout-petits. Le soir seulement; prix du poisson en hausse.

entries.name: Trattoria da Alex (formerly Colorado)
entries.area: Point E, near the Pharmacie du Point E.
fields: Italian and thick-crust pizza with a friendly Italian owner; eat in or delivery. RENAMED from Colorado.

Easy toddler choice (inference); delivery helps on nap days. SénéGuide reviewers say many menu items are unavailable (4.1 from 106; Tripadvisor 4.4). Regular menu with festive decoration at Christmas and New Year 2025.

sum.en: Italian restaurant and thick-crust pizza with a friendly Italian owner, an easy choice with toddlers, with delivery for nap days. Average 14,000 FCFA; opens 12:00. Renamed from Colorado.
sum.fr: Cuisine italienne et pizza à pâte épaisse, tenue par un patron italien chaleureux, un choix facile avec des tout-petits, avec livraison les jours de sieste. Moyenne de 14 000 FCFA; ouvre à 12:00. Ex-Colorado.

entries.name: Mawa's (Senegalese American Restaurant, "Taste of America")
entries.area: Hann Maristes / Hann Bel-Air (from base: 15 to 30 min, estimate).
fields: American brunch with pancakes, Saturday and Sunday from 9:00, in "une cour spacieuse et arborée" (a large tree-shaded courtyard) with bucolic decoration.
"À partir de 2 000 F CFA" (about CAD 4) (2023 article).
Shaded courtyard and early weekend opening make it a plausible toddler brunch close to Hann park (inference).

sum.en: American pancake brunch in a large tree-shaded courtyard, a plausible toddler brunch near Hann park. Saturday and Sunday from 9:00, from 2,000 FCFA; details date from 2023, so confirm.
sum.fr: Brunch américain de pancakes dans une grande cour ombragée, un brunch plausible avec des tout-petits près du parc de Hann. Samedi et dimanche dès 9:00, dès 2 000 FCFA; infos de 2023, à confirmer.

entries.name: The Spot Restaurant / Grill
entries.status: CONFIRM (photo date and current status not found).
fields: Grill with a Tripadvisor photo captioned "Aire de jeux et terrasse" (play area and terrace); a reviewer praised an outdoor play area at a birthday party.
One of the few restaurants with a pictured play area near the base.

sum.en: Grill with a pictured play area and terrace, one of the few restaurants with a play area near the base, and a reviewer praised it for a birthday party. Photo date and current status not found, so confirm.
sum.fr: Grill avec aire de jeux et terrasse en photo, l'un des rares restaurants avec une aire de jeux près de la base; un avis le loue pour une fête d'anniversaire. Date de la photo et statut actuel inconnus, à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Jardin Thaïlandais
fields: The only dedicated Thai restaurant found; garden with soft lighting

sum.en: The only dedicated Thai restaurant found, with a garden and soft lighting: a calm choice for a couple or the family. Open daily from 12:00 (undated); prices not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Le seul restaurant thaïlandais dédié trouvé, avec jardin et lumières douces: un choix calme pour un couple ou la famille. Ouvert tous les jours dès 12:00 (sans date); prix non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: Bazoff
fields: Lively evenings with football on screens; lunch only with toddlers

sum.en: Dibiterie serving skewers, fries, attiéké and aloko, an affordable local meal at 8,000 to 12,000 FCFA. Evenings are lively with football on screens, so go at lunch with toddlers.
sum.fr: Dibiterie de brochettes, frites, attiéké et aloko, un repas local abordable à 8 000 à 12 000 FCFA. Les soirées sont animées avec du football à l'écran: venez plutôt à midi avec des tout-petits.

entries.name: Casa Mara
fields: Spanish tapas, tortilla, sangria; quiet; probably the "CasaMara" named for its pool in a July 2026 guide (inference)

sum.en: Quiet Spanish spot with tapas, tortilla and sangria, good for a couple. The rooftop and pool need watching with toddlers. Probably the CasaMara named in a July 2026 guide; prices not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Adresse espagnole calme avec tapas, tortilla et sangria, idéale pour un couple. Le toit et la piscine demandent de la vigilance avec des tout-petits. Probablement le CasaMara d'un guide de juillet 2026; à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Phénix
fields: Renovated restaurant with several rooms and a garden where children can run

sum.en: Renovated restaurant with several rooms and a garden where children can run, a family option. Information comes from a 2019 blog, so confirm; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Restaurant rénové avec plusieurs salles et un jardin où les enfants peuvent courir, une option en famille. Information tirée d'un blog de 2019, à confirmer; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: O Good Food
fields: Burgers and a children's play area

sum.en: Burgers and a children's play area, a family-friendly stop for the little ones. Information comes from a January 2021 blog, so confirm; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Burgers et une aire de jeux pour enfants, une étape familiale pour les petits. Information tirée d'un blog de janvier 2021, à confirmer; prix et horaires non trouvés.

sum.en: Vietnamese restaurant, a change of cuisine for a couple or one adult. The source is undated, and prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant vietnamien, pour changer de cuisine à deux ou seul. La source n'est pas datée; prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Despite the name, a dibiterie, so grilled meat rather than Korean food. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Malgré son nom, une dibiterie, donc de la viande grillée plutôt que de la cuisine coréenne. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Sushi restaurant open 7 days, handy for an easy meal for a couple or one adult. Prices and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant de sushis ouvert 7 jours sur 7, pratique pour un repas simple à deux ou seul. Prix et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

entries.name: La Calebasse
entries.area: Route des Mamelles; Dakar Town gives "Rue NG-217, Ngor", which conflicts.
entries.status: UNCLEAR: an Airbnb listing marks it "permanently closed", while a Google review dated August 2026 and a roughly May 2026 travel post describe it as operating; Mapstr also mislabels it Japanese. CALL BEFORE GOING. Do not confuse with La Calebasse at the Novotel.
fields: Senegalese and West African institution with an African art gallery: thiéboudiène, yassa rice, attiéké, aloko with grills, salade Niokolo, mafé; two storeys with a covered rooftop terrace and live mbalax and dancing at weekends.
About 7,000 FCFA (about CAD 15) for a good meal per GoAfrica (undated); 10,000 to 15,000 (21 to 32) per Dakar Town (Jan 2025).
Weekend live music and dancing are loud; a weekday lunch would suit toddlers better (inference).

sum.en: Senegalese and West African institution with an African art gallery, a rooftop terrace and weekend live mbalax, about 7,000 FCFA a meal. Status unclear (one listing says closed): call before going.
sum.fr: Institution sénégalaise et ouest-africaine avec galerie d'art africain, terrasse sur le toit et mbalax en direct le week-end, environ 7 000 FCFA le repas. Statut incertain (fermé selon un site): appelez avant.

entries.name: Phare des Mamelles (bar-restaurant-club)
entries.area: Mamelles lighthouse hill; shuttle from the car park.
fields: Sunset terrace with local and international dishes; club nights Thursday to Saturday with a dance floor from about 23:00; Sunday brunch (traveller reports, possibly old). A December 2025 Christmas market ran here on Dec 14 from 16:00 (1,500 FCFA from 16:00).
Entry ticket including a drink from about 18:30; prices "a bit high", exact figures not found.
CONFLICT: Wednesday to Sunday evenings (Wednesday 17:00 to midnight; Saturday and Sunday from 9:30) per Evendo versus other listings. Lighthouse visits Tuesday to Sunday 9:00 to 18:00 (Section 4).
Not found; users advise booking at weekends.
Evening club atmosphere is unsuitable; the daytime lighthouse visit or Sunday brunch is the family window. A 2022 review alleges an assault by staff.

sum.en: Sunset terrace with local and international dishes; the family window is the daytime lighthouse visit or Sunday brunch, as club nights are not for toddlers. Hours conflict between sources; confirm.
sum.fr: Terrasse au coucher du soleil, plats locaux et internationaux; la fenêtre familiale est la visite du phare de jour ou le brunch du dimanche, les soirées club ne conviennent pas aux petits. Horaires contradictoires.

entries.name: Melo's Pâtisserie
fields: Very busy on Sundays; expect to wait, so go Saturday

sum.en: Pâtisserie with a praised brunch, a good morning stop for the family. Very busy on Sundays, so expect a wait and go on Saturday instead. Prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Pâtisserie au brunch très apprécié, une bonne halte matinale en famille. Très fréquentée le dimanche, avec de l'attente: préférez le samedi. Prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: O Petit Club Africain
fields: Senegalese with French influences; rooftop with a vintage vinyl collection

sum.en: Senegalese cuisine with French influences and a rooftop with a vintage vinyl collection, a mellow pick for a couple or one adult. Single source; prices and hours not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Cuisine sénégalaise aux influences françaises, avec un toit et sa collection de vinyles vintage, une adresse tranquille pour un couple ou un adulte seul. Source unique; prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: La Pointe des Almadies
entries.area: Pointe des Almadies, the westernmost tip of mainland Africa.
fields: Wood-fire grills, seafood and brunch; 4.4 from 232 reviews; its listing shows a swimming pool and a children's space ("Espace enfants"), one of the few Dakar restaurants with a documented kids' area.
Average 19,000 FCFA (about CAD 40); brunch 12,000 to 23,000 (26 to 49) at 2026 prices.
Not found; visitors complained in 2020 to 2021 that calls about brunch prices went unanswered.
Pool plus kids' space plus seafood makes it the best-documented toddler restaurant in Dakar; the pool and kids' space come from 2017 to 2021 listings, so confirm both are still there.

sum.en: Wood-fire grills, seafood and brunch, with a pool and a children's space, the best-documented toddler restaurant in Dakar. Average 19,000 FCFA; pool and kids' space date from old listings, so confirm.
sum.fr: Grillades au feu de bois, fruits de mer et brunch, avec piscine et espace enfants: le restaurant le mieux documenté pour les tout-petits à Dakar. Moyenne de 19 000 FCFA; piscine et espace enfants à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Cabanon
entries.area: Corniche des Almadies, on the sea.
fields: Seasonal Franco-Senegalese seafood by chef Daniel Garibaldi; official site live; 4.5 from 315 reviews; repeatedly called a Corniche "hidden gem with a view".
33 820 43 00 or 78 146 41 41; reservations via a WhatsApp link on the site.

All-day opening means an easy early lunch; directly on the sea, SEA-EDGE caution. Hosts Dakar Fashion Week's closing white party from 22:00 on Sun Dec 6, 2026 (adults, reservation required) per the earlier events research ([dakarfashionweek.com](https://dakarfashionweek.com)).

sum.en: Seasonal Franco-Senegalese seafood by chef Daniel Garibaldi, a Corniche hidden gem with a view. Open all day, 10:00 to 23:00, so an easy early lunch; average 22,500 FCFA. Directly on the sea, watch toddlers.
sum.fr: Fruits de mer franco-sénégalais de saison du chef Daniel Garibaldi, une pépite de la Corniche avec vue. Ouvert toute la journée, de 10:00 à 23:00, donc facile pour un déjeuner tôt; moyenne de 22 500 FCFA. Bord de mer.

entries.name: Noflaye Beach
entries.status: UNCLEAR: a Wanderlog list shows it "Temporarily Closed"; founding details conflict between sources. Confirm before going.
fields: Beach bar serving seafood, sweet crêpes, buckwheat galettes and salads; two-tier seating over the ocean; "affordable"; mixed service reviews.
Seating hangs over the ocean: SEA-EDGE caution.

sum.en: Beach bar with seafood, crêpes, galettes and salads, with two-tier seating over the ocean; affordable. Open daily 10:00 to 22:00, but one list shows it temporarily closed, so confirm. Sea edge, watch toddlers.
sum.fr: Bar de plage avec fruits de mer, crêpes, galettes et salades, assises sur deux niveaux au-dessus de l'océan; abordable. Ouvert tous les jours de 10:00 à 22:00, mais une liste le dit fermé temporairement: à confirmer.

entries.name: La Cabane du Surfeur
entries.area: Route des Almadies, near Le Vivier (whether "Vivier Beach" is the same venue is not confirmed).
entries.status: CONFIRM: the newest dated comment is June 2021; not re-verified for 2024 to 2026.
fields: French and Senegalese beach club with a small pool "ideal for families" and a playground with a slide and sand.
Children swim in the small pool with adult supervision required; limited toilets; some reviews criticise cleanliness.

sum.en: French and Senegalese beach club with a small pool described as ideal for families and a playground with a slide and sand. Daily 11:00 to 23:00, cash only; last comment dates from June 2021, so confirm.
sum.fr: Beach club franco-sénégalais avec petite piscine décrite comme idéale pour les familles et aire de jeux avec toboggan et sable. Tous les jours de 11:00 à 23:00, espèces seulement; dernier avis de juin 2021, à confirmer.

entries.name: Chez Fatou
entries.area: Petite Corniche, Almadies, above the waves.
fields: Senegalese food and brunch with a view of surfers and the Renaissance monument; a reviewer finds the "setting nicer than the food".
Sunday brunch must be ordered before noon (search summary of brunch listings).

sum.en: Senegalese food and brunch with a view of surfers and the Renaissance monument, though a reviewer finds the setting nicer than the food. Order Sunday brunch before noon. Sea edge, watch toddlers.
sum.fr: Cuisine sénégalaise et brunch avec vue sur les surfeurs et le monument de la Renaissance, même si un avis juge le cadre plus beau que la cuisine. Brunch du dimanche à commander avant midi. Bord de mer.

entries.name: Pointe des Almadies oyster and seafood stalls
fields: Row of simple stalls: oysters, cockles, brochettes
"Very affordable"; names and prices not found
Tables at the water's edge on rocks: hold toddlers

sum.en: Row of simple stalls serving oysters, cockles and brochettes, very affordable, for an adventurous seafood stop. Tables sit at the water's edge on rocks, so hold toddlers; prices not found.
sum.fr: Rangée de stands simples d'huîtres, de coques et de brochettes, très abordables, pour une halte fruits de mer sans chichi. Tables au bord de l'eau sur les rochers: tenez bien les tout-petits.

entries.name: Casa Teranga
fields: Plant-based café-restaurant; 4.5 from 195; city and lighthouse view; called the best vegan spot

sum.en: Plant-based café-restaurant with a city and lighthouse view, rated 4.5 from 195 reviews and called the best vegan spot. A calm choice for the family or a couple; opens 12:00.
sum.fr: Café-restaurant végétal avec vue sur la ville et le phare, noté 4.5 sur 195 avis et présenté comme la meilleure adresse vegan. Un choix calme pour la famille ou un couple; ouvre à 12:00.

entries.name: La Mer à Table
fields: Cape Verdean seafood platter, surf-facing terrace; Sunday salsa and kizomba socials

sum.en: Cape Verdean seafood platter on a surf-facing terrace, with Sunday salsa and kizomba socials: a lively pick for a couple. Sea-facing, so watch toddlers; prices and hours not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Plateau de fruits de mer capverdien sur une terrasse face aux vagues, avec soirées salsa et kizomba le dimanche: une adresse animée pour un couple. Face à la mer, surveillez les petits; à confirmer.

entries.name: Maison Madera
fields: Upscale Latin American grill; family Sunday brunch (Section 2)

sum.en: Upscale Latin American grill with a family Sunday brunch and free children's activities, a good fit for little ones. Brunch runs 11:00 to 16:00; prices are in Section 2.
sum.fr: Grill latino-américain haut de gamme avec brunch familial le dimanche et activités gratuites pour enfants, idéal pour les petits. Brunch de 11:00 à 16:00; les prix sont à la Section 2.

sum.en: Elegant restaurant with a view, rated 4.1 from 156 reviews, suited to a couple's dinner. Average 17,000 FCFA; hours not found. Single source and toddler suitability not documented, so confirm.
sum.fr: Restaurant élégant avec vue, noté 4.1 sur 156 avis, adapté à un dîner en couple. Moyenne de 17 000 FCFA; horaires non trouvés. Source unique, adaptation aux tout-petits non documentée, à confirmer.

entries.name: La Poesia
fields: Mediterranean and Middle Eastern; healthy Sunday brunch by the sea

sum.en: Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cooking with a healthy Sunday brunch by the sea, a pleasant family or couple outing. Seaside, so watch toddlers; prices and hours not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Cuisine méditerranéenne et moyen-orientale avec brunch sain du dimanche en bord de mer, une sortie agréable en famille ou en couple. En bord de mer, surveillez les petits; prix et horaires non trouvés.

sum.en: Congolese lounge with cocktails, rated 4.4 from 64 reviews: an evening outing for a couple. Opens 18:00, evening only, so not for toddlers; prices not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Lounge congolais avec cocktails, noté 4.4 sur 64 avis: une sortie du soir pour un couple. Ouvre à 18:00, le soir seulement, donc pas pour les tout-petits; prix non trouvés, à confirmer.

sum.en: Mediterranean restaurant-bar, an option for a couple's evening out. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant-bar méditerranéen, une option pour une soirée à deux. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Ocean-facing terrace that doubles as a party spot, for a couple or one adult rather than toddlers. Prices and hours not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Terrasse face à l'océan qui fait aussi lieu de fête, pour un couple ou un adulte seul plutôt que pour des tout-petits. Prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Restaurant-bar with little detail available, a possible drink or dinner stop for adults. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant-bar sur lequel on sait peu de choses, une étape possible pour un verre ou un dîner entre adultes. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Café known for avocado toast, but crowded, so it suits a quick adult breakfast more than a toddler outing. Prices and hours not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Café connu pour son avocado toast, mais bondé: plutôt pour un petit-déjeuner rapide entre adultes qu'une sortie avec des tout-petits. Prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: New matcha and brunch café, with 3 courses under 15,000 FCFA: a casual brunch for a couple or one adult. Based on a single undated TikTok, so confirm; hours and toddler notes not found.
sum.fr: Nouveau café matcha et brunch, avec 3 services pour moins de 15 000 FCFA: un brunch décontracté pour un couple ou un adulte seul. Basé sur un seul TikTok non daté, à confirmer; horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Black and White Beach
fields: Grilled fish with an Ngor island view

sum.en: Beach spot serving grilled fish with a view of Ngor island, a casual seaside lunch for the family. Beach setting, so keep an eye on toddlers; prices and hours not found, confirm.
sum.fr: Adresse de plage servant du poisson grillé avec vue sur l'île de Ngor, un déjeuner décontracté en bord de mer pour la famille. Plage: surveillez les tout-petits; prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer.

sum.en: Seafood and cocktails, an easy pick for a couple or one adult. Prices, hours and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Fruits de mer et cocktails, un choix simple pour un couple ou un adulte seul. Prix, horaires et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Beach bar known for sunsets, a drink spot for a couple or one adult rather than toddlers. Prices and hours not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Bar de plage connu pour ses couchers de soleil, un endroit pour un verre à deux ou seul plutôt qu'avec des tout-petits. Prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

sum.en: Known for an all-you-can-eat Sunday brunch, a relaxed group meal. Open daily 12:00 to 02:00; prices and toddler notes were not found, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Connu pour son brunch du dimanche à volonté, un repas détendu à plusieurs. Ouvert tous les jours de 12:00 à 02:00; prix et accueil des enfants non trouvés, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

entries.name: Taiyo / Fuji / O Sushi Bar
fields: Japanese: Taiyo excellent but expensive (Feb 2025 review); Fuji called the best sushi by a visitor; O Sushi Bar lunch formula 5,000 (11)

sum.en: Three Japanese options: Taiyo excellent but expensive, Fuji called the best sushi by a visitor, and O Sushi Bar with a lunch formula at 5,000 FCFA. Hours not found; confirm.
sum.fr: Trois adresses japonaises: Taiyo excellent mais cher, Fuji jugé meilleur sushi par un visiteur, et O Sushi Bar avec une formule midi à 5 000 FCFA. Horaires non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Ngor ("Le Ngor pieds dans l'eau")
entries.area: End of the Corniche des Almadies, on Ngor beach.
fields: Senegalese seafood institution: grouper thiéboudiène singled out by Ethiopian Airlines' Selamta magazine, monkfish skewers, honey prawns, seafood platters; multi-level terraces over the fishing fleet; #1 in Dakar Town's Senegalese top 10; 4.0 from 400+ Tripadvisor reviews.

Terrace and beach suit family meals; SEA-EDGE caution; go at lunch with one adult on toddler duty by the water. Reviews are mixed on value (a 2021 review: overpriced, rubbery prawns); the setting is the draw.

sum.en: Senegalese seafood institution with multi-level terraces over the fishing fleet; the grouper thiéboudiène is the highlight. 20,000 to 30,000 FCFA, daily 11:00 to 22:00. Go at lunch, sea edge for toddlers.
sum.fr: Institution sénégalaise de fruits de mer, terrasses étagées au-dessus de la flottille de pêche; le thiéboudiène au mérou est le plat phare. 20 000 à 30 000 FCFA, tous les jours de 11:00 à 22:00. Midi, bord de mer.

entries.name: Sunu Makane (Chez Seck)
entries.area: Ngor Island, first beach; a short boat ride from Ngor village beach.
fields: Family-run seafood restaurant and guesthouse included in Saveur's October 2024 guide: African dentex and white fish chosen daily, giant prawns, barracuda, praised monkfish stew.

Not found for regular meals. 2024 evening dinners with entertainment cost 15,000 FCFA including the crossing (about CAD 32); New Year's Eve 2024 party held. In 2016 its private jetty loungers cost 2,000 each (OLD).
CONFLICT: Saveur lists +221 77 647 81 66; au-senegal lists other numbers.

The guest boat is said to be free (public pirogue about 1,000 FCFA); a private Seck boat was described in 2016 as safer than the crowded public pirogue. No life-jacket information: bring toddler jackets (Section 4). Bring cash.

sum.en: Family-run seafood restaurant and guesthouse reached by boat, with daily fish, giant prawns and praised monkfish stew. Bring cash and toddler life jackets; regular prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Restaurant de poisson et maison d'hôtes familiale accessible en bateau, avec poisson du jour, gambas géantes et lotte réputée. Prévoyez des espèces et des gilets pour tout-petits; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Youyou
entries.status: CONFIRM (single source; identity with Boma YouYou unconfirmed).
fields: Italian, Senegalese, pizza and Mediterranean, breakfast through dinner; 4.7 from 130 reviews.

Not found for this listing. The YouYou restaurant at Hôtel Boma (Almadies) uses WhatsApp +221 77 737 38 41 and runs an adults-only (18+) pool; whether SénéGuide's "Youyou (Ngor)" is the same venue was not confirmed.
Early breakfast opening; do not plan on the Boma pool with toddlers.

sum.en: Italian, Senegalese, pizza and Mediterranean dishes, from breakfast to dinner, rated 4.7 from 130 reviews. Average 18,000 FCFA; opens 07:00, useful for early-rising toddlers. Single source, confirm.
sum.fr: Plats italiens, sénégalais, pizzas et méditerranéens, du petit-déjeuner au dîner, noté 4.7 sur 130 avis. Moyenne de 18 000 FCFA; ouvre à 07:00, pratique pour les tout-petits matinaux. Source unique, à confirmer.

entries.name: Seven Seven Steakhouse
fields: Steakhouse and grills; 4.8 from 877, the highest-volume high rating on SénéGuide

sum.en: Steakhouse and grills with the highest-volume high rating on SénéGuide, 4.8 from 877 reviews: a splurge dinner for a couple. Average 42,000 FCFA; opens 12:00.
sum.fr: Steakhouse et grillades à la note élevée la plus fournie de SénéGuide, 4.8 sur 877 avis: un dîner de fête pour un couple. Moyenne de 42 000 FCFA; ouvre à 12:00.

sum.en: Senegalese restaurant where the thiéboudiène is very appreciated, rated 4.6 from 51 reviews, a good lunch for the family. Opens 12:00; single source, so confirm.
sum.fr: Restaurant sénégalais où le thiéboudiène est très apprécié, noté 4.6 sur 51 avis, un bon déjeuner en famille. Ouvre à 12:00; source unique, à confirmer.

entries.name: Alkimia
fields: Senegalese and brunch over the Atlantic; air-conditioned rooms; concerts and themed nights; 4.5 from 149; service sometimes overwhelmed
Average 28,000 (60); Sunday brunch price not found
Lunch 12:00 to 15:30 several weekdays (one listing); Sunday brunch 12:00 to 16:30 with live DJ

sum.en: Senegalese cooking and brunch over the Atlantic, with air-conditioned rooms and live DJ on Sunday; the brunch reads adult-oriented. Average 28,000 FCFA; Sunday brunch 12:00 to 16:30.
sum.fr: Cuisine sénégalaise et brunch au-dessus de l'Atlantique, salles climatisées et DJ en direct le dimanche; le brunch semble plutôt pour adultes. Moyenne de 28 000 FCFA; brunch du dimanche de 12:00 à 16:30.

entries.name: Noliane, Noliane Caffè, Ella's
entries.area: Route du Méridien area (listed under Ngor)
fields: Italian fine dining by chef-owner Alessandro Merlo in a garden compound with a 20-room boutique hotel; 4.3 from 24, Tripadvisor 4.5
Restaurant opens 19:00; an Italian brunch 12:00 to 16:00 was announced Dec 2023, status unknown
Fine-dining dinner, not for toddlers (inference); the Caffè (French and Italian) is the daytime option

sum.en: Italian fine dining by chef-owner Alessandro Merlo in a garden compound with a boutique hotel, a dinner for a couple. Opens 19:00, average 54,000 FCFA; the Caffè is the daytime option for families.
sum.fr: Cuisine italienne gastronomique du chef-propriétaire Alessandro Merlo, dans un jardin avec hôtel de charme, un dîner pour un couple. Ouvre à 19:00, moyenne de 54 000 FCFA; le Caffè sert de choix de jour en famille.

entries.name: Reine Margarita
entries.area: Ngor, Route de l'aéroport opposite Stade de Ngor
fields: Italian and pizza: tagliatelle, polenta, focaccia; Tripadvisor 4.7 from 212; "doesn't look appealing from outside, but the food is very good"

sum.en: Italian and pizza, with tagliatelle, polenta and focaccia, rated 4.7 on Tripadvisor: it does not look appealing from outside, but the food is very good. An easy pizza stop with toddlers.
sum.fr: Cuisine italienne et pizzas, avec tagliatelles, polenta et focaccia, notée 4.7 sur Tripadvisor: l'extérieur n'a rien d'engageant, mais la cuisine est très bonne. Une halte pizza facile avec des tout-petits.

entries.name: La Cabane du Pêcheur
fields: Seafood: pasta with clams, ravioli; "not cheap", "expensive, more refined"; Tripadvisor 4.2

sum.en: Beachside seafood with clam pasta and ravioli, rated 4.2 on Tripadvisor: not cheap, more refined, so better for a couple. Prices and hours not found; mind toddlers on the beach.
sum.fr: Fruits de mer en bord de plage, pâtes aux palourdes et raviolis, notés 4.2 sur Tripadvisor: pas bon marché, plus raffiné, donc mieux pour un couple. Prix et horaires non trouvés; surveillez les petits sur la plage.

sum.en: Grill restaurant rated 4.3 from 104 reviews, an easy meat-focused meal. Average 22,000 FCFA; hours not found and toddler suitability not documented, so confirm before going.
sum.fr: Restaurant de grillades noté 4.3 sur 104 avis, un repas simple autour de la viande. Moyenne de 22 000 FCFA; horaires non trouvés et accueil des enfants non documenté, à confirmer avant d'y aller.

entries.name: Chez Carla, La Maison d'Italie
fields: Italian-Senegalese hotel-restaurant; Petit Futé 3.4/5 over 25, 2024 reviews praise the ocean-view terrace

sum.en: Italian-Senegalese hotel-restaurant on the calm south shore, with an ocean-view terrace praised in 2024 reviews. Petit Futé rates it 3.4 over 25; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Hôtel-restaurant italo-sénégalais sur la côte sud, au calme, avec une terrasse vue sur l'océan saluée dans les avis de 2024. Petit Futé le note 3.4 sur 25; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Complexe Keur Yaadikoone
fields: Waterside restaurant with its own 24-hour pirogue service
Own boat avoids the beach scrum

sum.en: Waterside restaurant with its own 24-hour pirogue service, so the boat trip avoids the beach scrum. New Year's Eve 2025 cost 25,000 FCFA with a free crossing; other prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Restaurant au bord de l'eau avec son propre service de pirogue 24 heures sur 24, qui évite la cohue de la plage. Réveillon 2025 à 25 000 FCFA avec traversée gratuite; autres prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Pizzammore
fields: Neapolitan pizza ranked **#100 in 50 Top Pizza World 2025** (three sources agree; a 2026 placement was not found); chef Gabriele Colombo per one listing; 4.3 from 114 reviews.
Pizza, mid-price and close to base: a good toddler dinner (inference).

sum.en: Neapolitan pizza ranked #100 in 50 Top Pizza World 2025, mid-price and close to base: a good toddler dinner. Average 13,500 FCFA, opens 13:00, 4.3 from 114 reviews.
sum.fr: Pizza napolitaine classée n° 100 au 50 Top Pizza World 2025, à prix moyen et proche de la base: un bon dîner avec de jeunes enfants. Compter 13 500 FCFA en moyenne; ouvre à 13:00.

entries.name: Stefy&Leo Risto-Beach
entries.area: Yoff BCEAO beach, the nearest beach strip to base.
fields: Small Italian restaurant facing the ocean: pasta, omelettes, grilled fish.
Good for sand play and lunch, not swimming: Yoff beach has surf and jet skis, and reviewers note plastic waste.

sum.en: Small Italian restaurant facing the ocean on Yoff BCEAO beach, the nearest beach strip to base: pasta, omelettes, grilled fish. Good for sand play and lunch, not swimming. Confirm before going.
sum.fr: Petit restaurant italien face à l'océan, sur la plage BCEAO de Yoff, la plus proche de la base: pâtes, omelettes, poisson grillé. Idéal pour jouer dans le sable et déjeuner, pas pour se baigner. À confirmer.

sum.en: Japanese dinner spot in Yoff, rated 4.9 from 29 reviews, with an average price of 13,000 and opening at 19:00. Single source, so confirm before you go.
sum.fr: Restaurant japonais à Yoff pour le dîner, noté 4,9 sur 29 avis, repas à 13 000 en moyenne, ouvert dès 19:00. Une seule source: à confirmer avant d'y aller.

entries.name: Lala Beach, La Paillote, Anima Pizzeria, Baja Beach, Sea And Salt
fields: Beach restaurants; Lala Beach praised for food and atmosphere

sum.en: Group of Yoff beach restaurants (Lala Beach, La Paillote, Anima Pizzeria, Baja Beach, Sea And Salt); Lala Beach is praised for food and atmosphere. Sand play only for little ones; confirm details.
sum.fr: Groupe de restaurants de plage à Yoff (Lala Beach, La Paillote, Anima Pizzeria, Baja Beach, Sea And Salt), Lala Beach étant réputé pour sa cuisine et son ambiance. Jeux de sable seulement; à confirmer.

entries.name: Chez Tonton
fields: Open since 1949; colourful terrace; thiéboudiène, chicken or fish yassa

sum.en: Gorée restaurant open since 1949 with a colourful terrace, serving thiéboudiène and chicken or fish yassa. A March 2025 blog says it is open; prices and hours not found.
sum.fr: Restaurant de Gorée ouvert depuis 1949, avec une terrasse colorée: thiéboudiène, yassa au poulet ou au poisson. Un blog de mars 2025 le dit ouvert; prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Chez Nene La Retrouvailles
fields: Traditional Senegalese, generous, affordable, port view

sum.en: Traditional Senegalese restaurant on Gorée, described as generous and affordable, with a view of the port. A simple lunch option on the island; single source, so confirm.
sum.fr: Restaurant sénégalais traditionnel à Gorée, copieux et abordable, avec vue sur le port. Une option simple pour déjeuner sur l'île; une seule source, à confirmer.

sum.en: Crêperie on Rue des Batteries, Gorée, rated 4.8 from 25 reviews; crêpes are easy toddler food (inference). Prices and hours not found, so confirm.
sum.fr: Crêperie de la rue des Batteries, à Gorée, notée 4,8 sur 25 avis; les crêpes passent facilement chez les tout-petits (déduction). Prix et horaires non trouvés, à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Boucanier, Chez Thio
entries.area: By the jetty (Chez Thio near Villa Castel)
entries.status: CONFIRM; Petit Futé marks several Gorée restaurants closed
fields: Next to the calm jetty beach

sum.en: Restaurants by the landing jetty on Gorée, next to the calm jetty beach, handy with small children. Petit Futé marks several Gorée restaurants closed, so confirm these are open.
sum.fr: Restaurants près de l'embarcadère de Gorée, à côté de la plage calme de la jetée, pratiques avec de jeunes enfants. Petit Futé en signale plusieurs de fermés à Gorée: à confirmer.

entries.name: Unnamed beachfront spots
fields: Grilled fish, seafood, salads, juices at midday
Lunch facing the port about €10 (about 6,560 FCFA, CAD 14) per person

sum.en: Beachfront spots on Gorée serving grilled fish, seafood, salads and juices at midday, a good lunch before the nap boat. Lunch facing the port is about €10 (6,560 FCFA) per person.
sum.fr: Restaurants en bord de plage à Gorée: poisson grillé, fruits de mer, salades et jus à midi, parfaits avant le bateau de la sieste. Compter environ 10 € (6 560 FCFA) par personne face au port.

entries.name: Maison Madera, "Grand brunch du dimanche"
entries.area: Corniche des Almadies (from base: 20 to 35 min, estimate).
fields: Upscale Latin American grill whose Sunday brunch includes **free children's activities: "cirque, jonglage, équilibre et jeux"** (circus, juggling, balance and games); confirmed as running in the SénéGuide weekly listing updated Nov 14, 2026.

25,000 FCFA per adult (about CAD 53) and 15,000 per child up to 12 (about CAD 32), drinks included; the event summary also says "dès 15 000 FCFA", so confirm the adult price. No minimum child age stated: for this family, 80,000 FCFA (about CAD 170) if both toddlers are charged, 50,000 (about CAD 106) if they are free.
The clearest 2026 example of a staffed family brunch; ask whether activities suit an 18-month-old.
entries.sources: [SénéGuide Maison Madera brunch](https://www.seneguide.com/sortir/maison-madera-grand-brunch-du-dimanche); [SénéGuide weekly listing, Nov 14, 2026](https://www.seneguide.com/sortir/super-brunch-au-noom); [SénéGuide Maison Madera](https://www.seneguide.com/restaurants/dakar/maison-madera).

sum.en: Upscale Latin American grill whose Sunday brunch has free children's activities: circus, juggling, balance and games. Sundays 11:00 to 16:00; 25,000 FCFA per adult, 15,000 per child up to 12; confirm adult price.
sum.fr: Grill latino-américain haut de gamme dont le brunch du dimanche propose des activités gratuites pour enfants: cirque, jonglage, équilibre et jeux. Dimanche 11:00 à 16:00; 25 000 FCFA l'adulte, 15 000 l'enfant jusqu'à 12 ans.

entries.name: Le Jardin d'Orient
fields: 18,000 FCFA per adult (about CAD 38); **"Gratuit pour les enfants de 0 à 7 ans"** (free for ages 0 to 7), so 36,000 FCFA (about CAD 77) for this family.
Best value for two under-4s. One review says a group was refused because it did not want the brunch formula.

sum.en: All-you-can-eat Sunday brunch, free for children aged 0 to 7: the best value for a family with two little ones. Sunday 11:00 to 16:00; 18,000 FCFA per adult.
sum.fr: Brunch du dimanche à volonté, gratuit pour les enfants de 0 à 7 ans: le meilleur rapport qualité-prix pour une famille avec deux petits. Dimanche 11:00 à 16:00, 18 000 FCFA par adulte.

sum.en: Hôtel Ngor Diarama on the Route de Ngor has two outdoor pools; an undated review gives 11,000 per adult. Toddler suitability not documented; confirm on +221 33 820 10 05.
sum.fr: L'Hôtel Ngor Diarama, route de Ngor, a deux piscines extérieures; un avis non daté indique 11 000 par adulte. Accueil des tout-petits non documenté; à confirmer au +221 33 820 10 05.

entries.name: Azalaï Hôtel Dakar
fields: Page mentions 15,000 (32) adult, but the table appears to belong to the Bamako hotel

sum.en: Azalaï Hôtel Dakar pool at Fann Résidence, Corniche Ouest, but the 15,000 adult price seems to belong to the Bamako hotel. Conflict, so call +221 33 923 23 00 to confirm.
sum.fr: Piscine de l'Azalaï Hôtel Dakar, Fann Résidence, Corniche Ouest, mais le tarif adulte de 15 000 semble concerner l'hôtel de Bamako. Information en conflit: appelez le +221 33 923 23 00.

entries.name: Boma Lifestyle / YouYou, Jardin Suspendu pool

sum.en: Heated pool with loungers and poolside service at Hôtel Boma, Almadies, daily 8:00 to 18:00. Adults only, 18+, so skip with toddlers; 10,000 weekdays, 12,000 weekends.
sum.fr: Piscine chauffée avec transats et service au bord de l'eau à l'Hôtel Boma, aux Almadies, tous les jours 8:00 à 18:00. Réservée aux adultes de 18 ans et plus: à éviter avec des tout-petits; 10 000 en semaine, 12 000 le week-end.

sum.en: Beach club pool on the Corniche des Almadies, with no family details and no price confirmed online, so confirm before planning a visit with small children.
sum.fr: Piscine de beach club sur la Corniche des Almadies, sans détail pour les familles et sans prix confirmé en ligne: à vérifier avant d'y emmener de jeunes enfants.

entries.name: CasaMara; Novotel Dakar
fields: Pools named in a July 2026 day-out guide

sum.en: CasaMara and Novotel Dakar pools in central Dakar and Plateau, named in a July 2026 day-out guide. No prices, hours or kids' facilities given, so confirm.
sum.fr: Les piscines de CasaMara et du Novotel Dakar, dans le centre et au Plateau, citées dans un guide de sorties de juillet 2026. Ni prix, ni horaires, ni équipements enfants: à confirmer.

sum.en: Pool with slides on Corniche Ouest, mainly for bigger children. Entry 5000 CFA for everyone, daily 10:00 to 18:00; July 2024 listing, so confirm. Phone +221 33 823 49 36.
sum.fr: Piscine avec toboggans sur la Corniche Ouest, surtout pour les plus grands. Entrée 5000 CFA pour tous, tous les jours 10:00 à 18:00; fiche de juillet 2024, à confirmer. Tél. +221 33 823 49 36.

entries.name: Le Gymnasium; Club Olympique
fields: Gymnasium 5,000 adult, 3,000 child from 4; Club Olympique 6,000 adult, 5,000 child, half price from 15:00

sum.en: Sports-club pools, with lessons at Le Gymnasium. Gymnasium 5,000 adult, 3,000 child from 4; Club Olympique 6,000 adult, 5,000 child, half price from 15:00. 2016 prices, so confirm.
sum.fr: Piscines de clubs sportifs, avec cours au Gymnasium. Gymnasium 5 000 adulte, 3 000 enfant dès 4 ans; Club Olympique 6 000 adulte, 5 000 enfant, moitié prix dès 15:00. Tarifs 2016, à confirmer.

entries.name: Hotel Savana, Onomo Dakar, Fleur de Lys

sum.en: Hotel Savana, Onomo Dakar and Fleur de Lys: no day-pass information surfaced for any of these three hotels. Not found, so contact them directly before counting on it.
sum.fr: Hotel Savana, Onomo Dakar et Fleur de Lys: aucune information de day pass n'a été trouvée pour ces trois hôtels. Introuvable; contactez-les directement avant de compter dessus.

entries.name: Parc forestier et zoologique de Hann (Hann zoo and forest park)
entries.area: Hann Bel-Air, "Hann Front de terre", about 6 km from central Dakar, between the Route des Pères Maristes, the Route du Front de terre and the railway (from base: 15 to 40 min, estimate).
entries.status: OPEN 2025-26; **NOT RENOVATED** (the page itself also says "peu entretenu, faute de moyens"); a separate undated Change.org petition targets the lions' conditions.
fields: Zoo opened in 1935 (187 animals in 2013): crocodiles, lions, Gambian geese, pythons, dingoes, guineafowl, dromedaries, turtles, pelicans, chimpanzees and baboons, parrots, plus a reptilarium for threatened snakes; the 1935 aquarium's current existence is unconfirmed. The surrounding forest is "calme et arboré" and used for walks, children's bike rides, pétanque and family picnics.

**Adults 500 FCFA (about CAD 1), children 300 FCFA (under CAD 1), confirmed for 2026; the forest area is free.** In 2016 the park had a paid children's play area and pony rides at 2,000 FCFA for 15 minutes (OLD).
**Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 to 13:00 and 15:00 to 18:30; closed Mondays** (undated listing); YouSenegal (Sep 2026) says Tuesday to Sunday "morning and late afternoon", to be checked on the day.
33 859 32 00 and (221) 33 832 38 75; a 2019 reader reported the number did not answer.

YouSenegal rates the zoo best for ages 4 to 7 and calls it "ancien et fragile", but its shaded lawns suit ages 0 to 3. Arrive at 10:00, do a short zoo loop, then the forest and the Les Nuages toddler corner, picnic, and leave before 13:00. Paths are uneven and stroller access is unverified: a carrier is safer. No information on toilets, baby-changing or the café.

sum.en: Hann zoo (opened 1935) with lions, crocodiles and pelicans, plus a free shaded forest for walks and picnics. Not renovated. Tue to Sun 10:00 to 13:00 and 15:00 to 18:30; adults 500 FCFA, children 300.
sum.fr: Zoo de Hann (ouvert en 1935) avec lions, crocodiles et pélicans, et forêt ombragée gratuite pour promenades et pique-niques. Non rénové. Mardi au dimanche 10:00 à 13:00 et 15:00 à 18:30; adultes 500 FCFA, enfants 300.

entries.name: Les Nuages perdent leurs plumes (leisure park inside Hann park)
entries.status: OPEN 2025-26 (listed May and July 2026); CONFIRM prices (2019).
fields: Climbing, zip line, slackline, mini golf, archery, monkey bridge, swings, creative workshops and paintball (from age 10); a July 2026 roundup adds bowling, trampolines and an obstacle course chosen by age; a **toddler corner ("coin des tout petits")** with its own pass.

2019 prices: toddler corner pass **3,000 FCFA (about CAD 6)**; "Jeux à gogo" all-games pass 5,000 per child (also cited in a recent review); picnic 2,000 per adult; tickets from 500; parents enter free. An older listing gives 1,000 entry.
The toddler corner is the reason to combine it with the zoo.

sum.en: Leisure park inside Hann forest with a toddler corner, plus climbing, zip line and mini golf for bigger children; the reason to pair it with the zoo. Toddler corner pass 3,000 FCFA (2019 price).
sum.fr: Parc de loisirs dans la forêt de Hann avec un coin des tout-petits, plus escalade, tyrolienne et mini-golf pour les plus grands: la bonne raison de le combiner avec le zoo. Pass tout-petits 3 000 FCFA (prix 2019).

entries.name: Réserve de Bandia (safari reserve near Sindia)
entries.area: Route Nationale N1 (Dakar to Mbour), between Sindia and Nguékokh, km 64 from Dakar, 15 km from Saly (from base: 1 h to 1 h 30 via the toll motorway, estimate).
fields: Vehicle-only safari with a mandatory guide: rhinoceros, zebras, giraffes (including babies), buffalo, Derby and Cape elands, oryx, roan antelope, nyala, waterbuck, kob, greater kudu, impala, dama and red-fronted gazelles, warthog, patas and green monkeys, jackal, mongoose, crocodile, giant tortoise, ostrich and 120+ bird species; a bar-restaurant overlooks the waterhole near a crocodile pond. The game drive takes about 2 hours, plus an optional 30-minute lion visit in an iron-fenced vehicle (age or height limits for it are unknown).

Undated tariff matched by a January 2026 report: **adult 12,000 FCFA (about CAD 26); child aged 3 to 12 7,000 (15); own car, taxi or coach 10,000 (21); mandatory guide 6,500 (14) per vehicle**; reserve safari vehicle 40,000 (85) for 8 to 11 seats or 60,000 (128) for up to 24. **This family in its own car: about 47,500 FCFA (about CAD 101), or 40,500 (86) if the older child is still under 3**; one tour operator says infants aged 0 to 2 ride free. CONFLICT: an undated Routard forum thread ("tarifs exorbitants") says a 4x4 is mandatory on top of the guide, while the tariff allows your own vehicle. Organised day trips: Travel With Dina, 25,500 FCFA flat (about CAD 54), jeep and guide included, leaving Dakar at 8:00, lunch extra (single dated departure on Sat Oct 25, 2025; +221 78 793 94 20); Cometrip, 30,000 per person (about CAD 64) with transport, 4x4, guide and safari truck, lions and meals extra; Civitatis, entry about 18.50 per person and 4x4 with guide about 72 per group (currency unclear, probably EUR).
No official website, phone or email found; the au-senegal page offers only a contact form.

Go at the 8:00 opening (cooler, animals active at the waterhole, and it fits nap timing; no source states a best time). Self-driving keeps car seats in use; reserve 4x4s probably have no child seats (inference). A tour listing says infants can ride in a pram or stroller. Reviews of the restaurant food are mixed ("standard" versus "very good"); a June 2024 visitor praised the guide, welcome and restaurant.

sum.en: Vehicle-only safari with a mandatory guide: rhinoceros, giraffes, zebras, ostrich and crocodile, about 2 hours. Daily 8:00 to 19:00; adult 12,000 FCFA, child aged 3 to 12 7,000, guide 6,500 per vehicle.
sum.fr: Safari en véhicule avec guide obligatoire: rhinocéros, girafes, zèbres, autruche et crocodile, environ 2 heures. Tous les jours 8:00 à 19:00; adulte 12 000 FCFA, enfant de 3 à 12 ans 7 000, guide 6 500 par véhicule.

entries.name: Accro Baobab Adventure and Aquabaobab
entries.area: Sindia, opposite the Bandia reserve, "à une heure de Dakar", 15 minutes from the Petite Côte.
fields: Treetop park "de 2 à 90 ans": the **"Mamelles" course has 12 stations for ages 3 to 10**, "Fouta Djallon" 18 stations for ages 10 to 16; Aquabaobab adds a pool, an artificial lake, slides and inflatables with lifeguard supervision; crêperie, snack bar and bar.

2025 holiday packages per child including climbing, AquaLight water activity and lunch: Accro Mamelles 22,000 FCFA (about CAD 47), Fouta Djallon 26,000 (55), range 16,000 to 26,000. Walk-in price for the youngest course outside packages not found (a "Tarifs" page exists but was not retrieved).

CONFLICT: "every day except Monday, 8:00 to 19:00", including holidays ([accro-baobab.com](https://www.accro-baobab.com)) versus "9:00 to 18:00, closed Monday" ([au-senegal, 2025](https://au-senegal.com/accrobaobab-un-endroit-genial-pour-les-enfants-pour-les-vacances-de-2025,17590.html)).
The 3-year-old may manage parts of the Mamelles course with help; the 18-month-old is limited to play areas and supervised water; birthday packages start at age 2. Toddler-specific rules unverified.

sum.en: Treetop park in Sindia: the Mamelles course has 12 stations for ages 3 to 10, plus Aquabaobab pool and slides. Holiday package 22,000 FCFA per child; hours conflict (8:00 to 19:00 or 9:00 to 18:00), closed Monday.
sum.fr: Parc d'accrobranche à Sindia: parcours Mamelles à 12 ateliers pour les 3 à 10 ans, plus piscine et toboggans Aquabaobab. Forfait vacances 22 000 FCFA par enfant; horaires en conflit (8:00 à 19:00 ou 9:00 à 18:00), fermé le lundi.

entries.name: Village des Tortues (Centre de protection des tortues du Sénégal)
entries.area: Noflaye, just after Sangalkam on the Lac Rose road, 35 km east of Dakar, inside the Noflaye botanical reserve (more than 15 ha).
fields: Guided visits to sulcata tortoises (the largest mainland tortoise, up to 100 kg), leopard and radiated tortoises, aquatic turtles, nurseries and hatcheries; recommended for families in 2024 and July 2026.
Visitors 3,500 FCFA adult (about CAD 7) and 2,000 child (about CAD 4); residents or groups 2,500 / 1,500; Senegalese 2,000 / 1,000. Child age band not stated.
Slow, gentle animals at toddler eye level; an easy stop on the way to Lac Rose (inference).

sum.en: Guided visits to sulcata, leopard and radiated tortoises at Noflaye, an easy stop on the way to Lac Rose, with slow, gentle animals at toddler eye level. Daily 9:00 to 19:00; adult 3,500 FCFA, child 2,000.
sum.fr: Visites guidées de tortues sulcata, léopard et radiées à Noflaye, étape facile sur la route du Lac Rose: animaux lents et doux à hauteur de tout-petit. Tous les jours 9:00 à 19:00; adulte 3 500 FCFA, enfant 2 000.

entries.name: Hôtel et Parc Le Mbossé
entries.area: Lac Rose, about 33 km from Dakar.
fields: Small animal park (deer, ducks, warthogs, boubou monkeys, parrots) with a pool and a children's area.

**Day package with meal, park visit and pool: adults 10,000 FCFA (about CAD 21), children 7,000 (about CAD 15)**, the child price confirmed in May 2026; park visit only 2,000 per person (about CAD 4).
Animals, a pool and lunch in one fenced place: the best-value toddler day found near Lac Rose.

sum.en: Small animal park at Lac Rose with deer, warthogs, monkeys, a pool and a children's area: the best-value toddler day found near Lac Rose. Day package with meal, park and pool: adults 10,000 FCFA, children 7,000.
sum.fr: Petit parc animalier au Lac Rose avec cerfs, phacochères, singes, piscine et espace enfants: la journée la plus avantageuse pour les tout-petits près du Lac Rose. Forfait repas, parc et piscine: adultes 10 000 FCFA, enfants 7 000.

entries.name: Réserve naturelle urbaine de la Grande Niaye de Pikine (Technopole)
entries.area: Pikine, at the entrance to the suburbs, very close to base (inference from geography).
fields: Urban nature reserve created by decree on March 29, 2019; about 650 ha (one guide says 300 ha); about 237 to 239 bird species including cormorants, great egret, grey heron and little grebe; marked trails; construction is encroaching.
Entry 2,500 FCFA (about CAD 5) per a tourism listing.
Listed for educational outings and family walks; wetland, so evening mosquitoes (Section 7).

sum.en: Urban nature reserve in Pikine, probably close to base, with marked trails and about 237 to 239 bird species; listed for family walks. Wetland, so evening mosquitoes. Entry 2,500 FCFA per a tourism listing.
sum.fr: Réserve naturelle urbaine à Pikine, probablement proche de la base, avec sentiers balisés et environ 237 à 239 espèces d'oiseaux; citée pour les promenades en famille. Zone humide: moustiques le soir. Entrée 2 500 FCFA.

entries.name: Les Chevaux du Lac
entries.area: Lac Rose north shore, about 30 km
fields: 1 h 30: 17,000 (36), or 15,000 (32) with a Gîte du Lac stay or Bonaba café meal; 3 h: 35,000 (74)
No pony, child offer or minimum age stated

sum.en: Horse rides on the north shore of Lac Rose: 1 h 30 for 17,000 (15,000 with a Gîte du Lac stay or Bonaba café meal), 3 h for 35,000. No pony, child offer or minimum age stated, so ask.
sum.fr: Balades à cheval sur la rive nord du Lac Rose: 1 h 30 à 17 000 (15 000 avec séjour au Gîte du Lac ou repas au café Bonaba), 3 h à 35 000. Ni poney, ni offre enfant, ni âge minimum indiqués: renseignez-vous.

entries.name: Gîte du Lac
entries.area: Between Lac Rose and the Grande Côte (Bonaba)
fields: Family-suited lodge: horse rides, pirogue crossings, hiking, mountain biking

sum.en: Family-suited lodge between Lac Rose and the Grande Côte (Bonaba) offering horse rides, pirogue crossings, hiking and mountain biking. Prices and hours not found; listed as suited to families.
sum.fr: Lodge adapté aux familles entre le Lac Rose et la Grande Côte (Bonaba): balades à cheval, traversées en pirogue, randonnée et VTT. Prix et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Parc Exotique du Sénégal
entries.area: Nguérigne / Nguering, near Somone and Ngaparou
fields: 150+ exotic parrot species plus local wildlife, children's area; hotel on site (Section 5)

sum.en: Exotic park near Somone and Ngaparou with 150+ exotic parrot species, local wildlife and a children's area; hotel on site with rooms from 55,000. Entry price and hours not found.
sum.fr: Parc près de Somone et de Ngaparou avec plus de 150 espèces de perroquets exotiques, faune locale et espace enfants; hôtel sur place, chambres dès 55 000. Prix d'entrée et horaires non trouvés.

entries.name: Somone lagoon pirogue
fields: 700 ha reserve, pelicans, herons, seasonal flamingos (Section 5)
Calm water; life jackets for toddlers not documented

sum.en: Pirogue trip on the Somone lagoon, a 700 ha reserve with pelicans, herons and seasonal flamingos, on calm water. Best October to June; organised day 25,000. Toddler life jackets not documented.
sum.fr: Sortie en pirogue sur la lagune de la Somone, réserve de 700 ha avec pélicans, hérons et flamants saisonniers, sur une eau calme. Meilleure d'octobre à juin; journée organisée 25 000. Gilets pour tout-petits non documentés.

entries.name: Fathala Wildlife Reserve
fields: Lion walk 150 cm minimum (reseller); lodge bars ages 4 and under

sum.en: Game drives and lion walks in the Sine-Saloum, marked skip for this trip. Day trip 65,000 per person; lion walk needs 150 cm minimum and the lodge bars ages 4 and under.
sum.fr: Safaris et marches avec les lions dans le Sine-Saloum, à éviter pour ce séjour. Excursion à 65,000 par personne; marche avec lions dès 150 cm, lodge interdit aux 4 ans et moins.

entries.name: Pick N Play (soft play, arcade and virtual games)
entries.area: "Sur la route de l'aéroport à côté de ARC hôtel" (airport road next to ARC Hôtel), around Yoff and the old airport (from base: 10 to 25 min, estimate).
fields: Soft play plus arcade and virtual-reality game cards.

Soft play **1 hour 5,000 FCFA per child (about CAD 11); 2 hours 7,500 (about CAD 16); accompanying adult 2,000 (about CAD 4)**; game cards 5,000 to 30,000. For the wife with both toddlers for one hour: about 12,000 FCFA (about CAD 26), assuming the 18-month-old is charged as a child (not confirmed).
Published only as an image that could not be read.
The closest soft play to base, with the clearest current prices.

sum.en: The closest soft play to base, with clear current prices: 1 hour 5,000 FCFA per child, 2 hours 7,500, adult 2,000. Hours are not readable online; WhatsApp +221 78 685 99 79.
sum.fr: Le jeu souple le plus proche de la base, avec des tarifs récents clairs : 1 heure 5 000 FCFA par enfant, 2 heures 7 500, adulte 2 000. Horaires illisibles : WhatsApp +221 78 685 99 79.

entries.name: Mikado ("Mikado Friendly")
entries.area: 443 Avenue des Ambassadeurs, Fann Résidence (from base: 30 to 50 min, estimate).
fields: Family play and activity centre over more than 4,000 m² (search summary), indoor and outdoor, with play, educational and creative activities for children, parents and grandparents run by trained instructors; "de nombreux jeux, beaucoup de place, un espace climatisé, des animateurs compétents, un restaurant pour les parents". A reviewer notes "there are not many kid places in Dakar".
Not found (address from a May 2026 workshop announcement).
Air-conditioned, staffed and with a parents' café: the best purpose-built midday refuge.

sum.en: Air-conditioned play and activity centre, indoor and outdoor, with trained staff and a parents' restaurant: the best purpose-built midday refuge. Price and hours not found.
sum.fr: Grand centre de jeux climatisé, intérieur et extérieur, avec animateurs et restaurant pour les parents : le meilleur refuge de midi. Tarifs et horaires introuvables.

entries.name: Wonder Park (Wonderpark), probably also listed as "Parc des Merveilles"
entries.area: Place du Souvenir Africain, Corniche Ouest area (from base: 25 to 40 min, estimate).
entries.status: CONFIRM (comments from Sep and Oct 2024; price unverified).
fields: Family park with a soft-play area for "enfants en bas âge" under parental supervision, an aquatic zone for all ages, trampolines, a family restaurant and birthday parties; a reviewer says it is clean and staffed with monitors. YouSenegal lists a "Parc des Merveilles" at the same square for ages 3 to 12 with workshops; likely the same venue (inference).

"From 10,000 FCFA per day for ages 3 to 11" with pool and trampoline (about CAD 21), from a search summary of wonderpark.sn; **unverified**, because the site's security certificate had expired on Nov 13, 2026.
Soft play for young toddlers plus water.

sum.en: Family park with soft play for little ones, a water zone and trampolines. Price from 10,000 FCFA per day for ages 3 to 11 is unverified, and 2024 comments only; confirm first.
sum.fr: Parc familial avec jeux souples pour les tout-petits, zone aquatique et trampolines. Tarif dès 10 000 FCFA par jour pour les 3 à 11 ans non vérifié, avis de 2024 : à confirmer.

entries.name: Sea Plaza mall: Playtorium, food court and bowling
entries.area: Corniche Ouest, next to Noom (formerly Radisson Blu) (from base: 30 to 50 min, estimate).
fields: Mall with a food court and about 7 restaurants, bowling and arcade (2016), supermarket and pharmacy; store counts vary (70, 75 or 83); reviewers call it family-friendly with visible security. **Playtorium** is a covered, air-conditioned play area for ages 2 to 12, called the best refuge from the heat by a September 2026 family guide. A Laser Park opened in the Seanema on Feb 22, 2023 (older kids); a children's esplanade event on Dec 30, 2023 cost 10,000 per child.
One listing gives Sunday to Friday 10:00 to 20:00 and Saturday until midnight; sources conflict.

sum.en: Mall with food court, bowling and Playtorium, an air-conditioned play area for ages 2 to 12: a practical heat refuge. Sources conflict on hours, one listing says 10:00 to 20:00 Sunday to Friday.
sum.fr: Centre commercial avec restauration, bowling et Playtorium, aire de jeux climatisée pour les 2 à 12 ans : un refuge pratique contre la chaleur. Horaires contradictoires, une source dit 10:00 à 20:00.

entries.name: Magic Land and Terre Magique
fields: Magic Land is a theme park with mechanical rides and a tall Ferris wheel, single-ride tickets from age 3, busy on weekend evenings, plus the Aqualand pool (Section 2). Terre Magique next door has gentle rides for ages 2 to 10, and the "manèges de la Corniche" have gentle rides for ages 4 to 7.
Ride prices not found; Aqualand 5,000 (about CAD 11) for everyone (2024).
Magic Land Monday to Sunday 14:00 to 22:00 (Dec 2025 listing).

Dakaractu reported ride malfunctions, ignored age limits and recurring accidents in Dakar amusement parks including Magic Land, whose manager declined to answer; it also reported an abandoned, rusted ride on the Corniche Ouest. Gentle rides for the 3-year-old only, with a parent checking each one.

sum.en: Corniche theme park with a Ferris wheel and gentle rides at Terre Magique, but safety reports on Dakar rides call for a parent checking each one. Magic Land 14:00 to 22:00 daily.
sum.fr: Parc d'attractions de la Corniche avec grande roue et manèges doux à Terre Magique; des incidents signalés imposent qu'un parent vérifie chaque manège. Magic Land 14:00 à 22:00 tous les jours.

sum.fr: Espaces de jeux et restaurant familial dans un centre commercial, le plus proche de la base. À confirmer; tarifs et horaires introuvables, Facebook @kidzpalaceofficiel.

sum.fr: Espace de jeux calme conçu pour les tout-petits et les enfants du primaire, au centre commercial Sahm, ouvert selon un guide de septembre 2026. Tarifs et horaires introuvables.

sum.fr: Jeux électroniques et aquatiques pour enfants, avec restaurant pour les parents, au centre Les Quatre C. À confirmer; prix, horaires et adaptation aux tout-petits non documentés.

sum.fr: Centre de vacances avec réalité virtuelle, pédalos de plage, manèges et mini-voitures électriques. Vu en août 2024 : à confirmer; lieu, prix et horaires introuvables.

sum.en: Weekend circus classes with acrobatics and trampoline at the Piscine Olympique, but for ages 4 to 16 only, so not yet for this family. Price not found.
