sum.en: Toubacouta hotel with 50 AC rooms and an outdoor pool; family rooms are not mentioned. From 38,000 per person half board; confirm.
sum.fr: Hôtel à Toubacouta, 50 chambres climatisées et piscine extérieure ; chambres familiales non mentionnées. Dès 38 000 par personne en demi-pension ; à confirmer.

entries.name: Les Palétuviers
fields: From 97,000 (€149, CAD 206); HotelsCombined cheapest $395 per night (Mar 2, 2026)

sum.en: Boutique hotel in Toubacouta for a couple or one adult wanting a quiet Saloum stay. Rooms from 97,000 FCFA; child rates not found, so confirm before booking.
sum.fr: Hôtel de charme à Toubacouta, pour un couple ou un adulte seul en quête de calme dans le Saloum. Chambres dès 97 000 FCFA; tarifs enfants introuvables, à confirmer avant de réserver.

entries.name: Les Cordons Bleus
fields: Up to 50 guests, new infinity pool, open all year

sum.en: Ndangane lodge for up to 50 guests with a new infinity pool, open all year and reachable by car, which helps with toddlers. Prices not found; info from 2018, confirm.
sum.fr: Lodge à Ndangane pour 50 personnes au plus, avec piscine à débordement neuve, ouvert toute l'année et accessible en voiture, pratique avec de jeunes enfants. Prix introuvables; infos 2018, à confirmer.

entries.name: Hakuna Lodge
entries.area: Mar Lodj island, boat from Ndangane
fields: 17 fan-cooled (not AC) bungalows, 5 family-sized; children's playground, canoeing, fishing
From 20,000 per room with breakfast in high season (43), undated and likely old
Boat-only and fan rooms: harder with toddlers at night

sum.en: Mar Lodj island lodge with fan-cooled bungalows, five of them family-sized, plus a children's playground, canoeing and fishing. Boat only and no AC, so harder at night with toddlers; confirm.
sum.fr: Lodge sur l'île de Mar Lodj avec bungalows ventilés, dont cinq pour familles, aire de jeux, canoë et pêche. Accès en bateau et sans clim, plus dur la nuit avec des tout-petits; à confirmer.

entries.name: Le Kooniguy; Campement Essamaye
fields: Kooniguy: pool, pétanque, horse-cart island tours; Essamaye: about ten rooms, net fishing

sum.en: Two stays on Mar Lodj island reached by boat: Le Kooniguy with a pool, pétanque and horse-cart island tours, and Campement Essamaye with about ten rooms. Info from 2018; confirm.
sum.fr: Deux séjours sur l'île de Mar Lodj, accessibles en bateau: Le Kooniguy avec piscine, pétanque et tours de l'île en charrette, et Campement Essamaye avec une dizaine de chambres. Infos 2018, à confirmer.

entries.name: Au Souimanga Lodge; La Source aux Lamantins; Boundao Lodge
fields: Souimanga: small upscale lodge with lagoon-style pool; Source aux Lamantins: eco-lodge with children's environmental workshops; Boundao: 6 huts, shaded pool

sum.en: Three Saloum lodges: Au Souimanga with a lagoon-style pool, La Source aux Lamantins with children's environmental workshops, and Boundao with shaded pool. Info from 2018; confirm.
sum.fr: Trois lodges du Saloum: Au Souimanga avec piscine façon lagon, La Source aux Lamantins avec ateliers d'environnement pour enfants, et Boundao avec piscine ombragée. Infos 2018, à confirmer.

entries.name: Royal Lodge; Les Calaos du Saloum

sum.en: Two quiet options in the Saloum: Royal Lodge, a secluded hotel in Palmarin, and Les Calaos du Saloum, garden accommodation near Sokone. Prices and toddler facilities not documented; confirm.
sum.fr: Deux adresses tranquilles dans le Saloum: Royal Lodge, hôtel isolé à Palmarin, et Les Calaos du Saloum, hébergement en jardin près de Sokone. Prix et équipements pour enfants non documentés; à confirmer.

entries.name: Cap Saint-Louis
fields: Beach hotel with 35 round, air-conditioned sea-view bungalows (25 rooms, 10 duplexes), a large pool and a beachside restaurant; au-senegal's 2024 round-up calls it "un cadre idéal pour des vacances en famille".
AC bungalows, pool and beach make it the Saint-Louis toddler base; no source covers beach or current safety at Hydrobase for small children.

sum.en: Beach hotel on the Langue de Barbarie with air-conditioned sea-view bungalows, a large pool and a beachside restaurant: the best toddler base in Saint-Louis. Price not found; beach safety unchecked.
sum.fr: Hôtel de plage sur la Langue de Barbarie avec bungalows climatisés vue mer, grande piscine et restaurant sur la plage: la meilleure base avec de jeunes enfants à Saint-Louis. Prix introuvable; sécurité de la plage non vérifiée.

entries.name: Hôtel de la Poste
fields: Historic Aéropostale hotel, 37 to 39 rooms and suites, operating as of an October 2026 feature; pool not mentioned.
Rooms from 40,000 FCFA (about CAD 85), suites from 80,500 (171) (undated); HotelsCombined average €166 per night (Mar 2026); Momondo average about €80.
On the island, walking distance to the Fanal parades.

sum.en: Historic Aéropostale hotel on Saint-Louis island, walking distance to the Fanal parades, good for a couple or family. Rooms from 40,000 FCFA, suites from 80,500; pool not mentioned.
sum.fr: Hôtel historique de l'Aéropostale sur l'île de Saint-Louis, à pied des défilés du Fanal, idéal pour un couple ou une famille. Chambres dès 40 000 FCFA, suites dès 80 500; piscine non mentionnée.

entries.name: Fanal de Saint-Louis (lantern parade honouring the signares)
entries.area: Place Baya Ndar and the island streets.
fields: Neighbourhood lantern processions plus an OFF programme of concerts, theatre, slam and fashion; cancelled once, in 2015.

The 24th edition ran **Dec 24 to 31, 2024** (procession Mon Dec 30 at 20:30 per the earlier events research); 2022 ran Dec 24 to Jan 1; a listing says "usually Dec 28 to 30" (low reliability). **2026 dates not announced**; expected Dec 24 to 30 or 31.
Night-time and crowded: pick an early-evening viewing spot near the hotel rather than the full parade; Fanal week tightens island hotel availability.

sum.en: Saint-Louis lantern processions honouring the signares, with concerts, theatre and slam. Free. 2026 dates not announced, expected Dec 24 to 30 or 31; with toddlers choose an early-evening spot.
sum.fr: Défilés de lanternes à Saint-Louis en l'honneur des signares, avec concerts, théâtre et slam. Gratuit. Dates 2026 non annoncées, attendues du Dec 24 au 30 ou 31; avec des tout-petits, restez tôt en soirée.

entries.name: Lompoul: Eden Lodge and Ecolodge de Lompoul
entries.area: Lompoul desert, about 150 km north of Dakar.
entries.status: OPEN 2025-26; site threatened by zircon mining since 2025.
fields: Tented camps in the dunes. **Ecolodge de Lompoul** (also "Lodge de Lompoul") is rated 9.3 from 98 reviews, offers childcare at extra cost and free continental breakfast, and a family of four found the tent very large with foam mattresses added on the floor. **Eden Lodge** tents have a double and a single bed with private toilet and shower, and become **family tents for 2 adults and 4 children** on request. Camp Rêve de Nomade rates 4.5 from 70 Google reviews, and a family guide notes children love sandboarding; Camp Lodge in Lompoul has one 8.0 review from January 2025, which also mentions a mine near the dunes.
Not found for any Lompoul camp.
One night, splitting the Saint-Louis drive; the camp arranges the 4x4 for the last sandy stretch.

sum.en: Tented camps in the Lompoul dunes, a one-night stop on the Saint-Louis drive; Eden Lodge offers family tents and Ecolodge de Lompoul childcare at extra cost. Prices not found; mining threatens the site.
sum.fr: Camps de tentes dans les dunes de Lompoul, une nuit sur la route de Saint-Louis; Eden Lodge propose des tentes familiales, l'Ecolodge de Lompoul une garde d'enfants payante. Prix introuvables; site menacé par une mine.

entries.name: Transair flights to Cap Skirring and Ziguinchor
entries.area: Dakar to Cap Skirring and Dakar to Ziguinchor.
fields: **Dakar to Cap Skirring** resumed Mar 12, 2026, about 45 minutes, Monday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday: from Dakar Monday 11:30 (arrives 12:15) and Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 15:00 (arrives 15:45); from Cap Skirring Monday 12:45 and Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 16:30. **Dakar to Ziguinchor** relaunched May 1, 2026 after the airport reopened, described as daily though the timetable shown excludes Thursday; Monday departs 09:00, other days 15:00. An undated Air Journal article describes an Air Sénégal Cap Skirring route with two weekly ATR 72-600 flights; Air Sénégal's 2026 domestic service was not confirmed.

Cap Skirring from about **68,000 FCFA one way (about CAD 145) and 116,000 return (247)** per person; Ziguinchor from 39,500 one way (84) and 79,000 return (168). Infant and child fares not found. For two adults to Cap Skirring and back: 232,000 FCFA (about CAD 494) before any toddler fares.
As above; December 2026 schedule not found.

A Saturday-to-Wednesday or Wednesday-to-Sunday rotation fits a 4 to 5 night stay and avoids the Ziguinchor road. In October 2026 hoteliers called delays, changes and cancellations "un frein majeur", so build a buffer day before Christmas Eve plans or the Jan 2 departure.

sum.en: Transair flies Dakar to Cap Skirring in about 45 minutes, four days a week, from 68,000 FCFA one way; Ziguinchor from 39,500. Child fares not found and delays are common, so keep a buffer day.
sum.fr: Transair relie Dakar à Cap Skirring en 45 minutes environ, quatre jours par semaine, dès 68 000 FCFA l'aller; Ziguinchor dès 39 500. Tarifs enfants introuvables et retards fréquents: prévoyez un jour de marge.

entries.name: COSAMA ferry Dakar to Ziguinchor
entries.area: Dakar maritime station to Ziguinchor, calling at Carabane for one hour.
fields: The **Aline Sitoé Diatta** (about 500 passengers, cabins and a restaurant) leaves Dakar Tuesday and Friday (boarding 14:30 to 17:30, departure 20:00, arrival 10:00 next day) and returns Thursday and Sunday (13:00 to 07:00). The Diambogne and Aguène (seats only, no restaurant) leave Dakar Thursday and Sunday at 20:00, arriving 11:00. In 2025 the Aline was out of service for maintenance from Jun 30 to Aug 19.

Aline, resident / non-resident: 1st class 2-berth cabin 26,500 / 30,500; 2nd class 4-berth cabin 24,500 / 28,500; 3rd class 8-berth cabin 12,500 / 18,500; Pullman seat 5,000 / 15,500. Diambogne and Aguène: 5,000 / 15,900. **Children 5 to under 12 pay half; babies under 4 travel free.** For this family in a 4-berth cabin, two non-resident adults pay 57,000 FCFA (about CAD 121) one way with both toddlers free; Senegalese nationals pay the resident rate.
As above; some fares date from 2015.
batobi.sn; Dakar maritime station +221 33 821 29 00; Ziguinchor +221 33 991 72 00 (a May 2024 comment said online booking was not possible).
Feasible in a cabin but long; no 2026 timetable or fare sheet found.

sum.en: Overnight COSAMA ferry from Dakar to Ziguinchor with cabins, a stop at Carabane, babies under 4 free and children 5 to under 12 half price. Long but feasible in a cabin; no 2026 timetable found.
sum.fr: Ferry de nuit COSAMA de Dakar à Ziguinchor avec cabines et escale à Carabane, gratuit pour les bébés de moins de 4 ans, demi-tarif de 5 à moins de 12 ans. Long mais faisable en cabine; horaires 2026 introuvables.

fields: All-inclusive resort; the season launched around Oct 18, 2026 with a 175-passenger charter from France. The resort page lists only a teen club ("Kids Club 11-17 ans") and **no Baby, Petit or Mini Club**; an agency page says "Les enfants sont sous la surveillance de leurs parents ou accompagnants", the freshwater main pool opens 08:00 to 19:00, excursions start at age 4 (bolongs, Carabane, mangroves, about CAD 100 to 152 per person) and golf is free from age 8. Club Med's general bands (Baby Club 4 to 23 months, Petit Club 2 to 3 years, both extra cost at selected resorts) are not shown for Cap Skirring.
Opening date CONFLICT: Nov 25, 2026 per winter promotional terms versus "before Sep 26, 2026" with a season to May 29, 2027 per a September offer page.
Meals included, but parents provide all care for under-4s.

sum.en: All-inclusive Club Med at Cap Skirring, but no Baby, Petit or Mini Club is listed, so parents provide all care for under-4s. Opening date conflicts: Nov 25, 2026 or earlier; confirm.
sum.fr: Club Med tout compris à Cap Skirring, mais aucun Baby, Petit ou Mini Club n'est indiqué: les parents gardent seuls les moins de 4 ans. Date d'ouverture contradictoire (Nov 25, 2026 ou avant); à confirmer.

entries.name: Sonatel and Orange Sénégal
fields: **Sonatel and Orange Sénégal are the strongest commercial door.** At Journée Orange 2026 (reported Oct 29), CEO **Brelotte Bâ** set the slogan "My Customer, My Boss", sending audit, finance and commercial staff to listen to customers ("Le vrai boss, ce n'est pas le directeur général, c'est le client !"), and Consumer Marketing Director **Mamadou Bousso** presented **Wolof voice commands in the Max it super-app** for buying data and paying fibre bills, plus daily-instalment fibre payments of 500 or 1,000 FCFA a day on a 14,900 FCFA bill ([Osiris](https://www.osiris.sn/journee-orange-2026-sonatel-simplifie-ses-services-avec-la-commande-vocale-en.html)). Sonatel's stated 2026 priorities are 5G and **AI embedded in customer experience and internal processes**, and Orange frames local-language AI as its African customer-experience differentiator ([Senego](https://senego.com/sonatel-annonce-ses-priorites-infrastructures-5g-et-intelligence-artificielle_1987828.html); [Osiris](https://osiris.sn/experience-client-en-afrique-orange-mise-sur-l-ia-dans-les-langues-locales.html)); in 2024 Orange said Wolof and Pulaar would come first in its African-language AI work with Meta and OpenAI ([Semafor](https://semafor.com/article/11/27/2024/orange-partners-with-meta-and-openai-for-african-languages-ai-models)). Group 2025 net income rose 5.1% ([allAfrica](https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202602180387.html)). Entry points are SIPEN and the CNP Assises (Dec 18 to 19), the Orange Digital Center, or a warm introduction through GalsenAI or AI Hub Sénégal people.

sum.en: Sonatel and Orange Sénégal, the strongest commercial door: Wolof voice commands in the Max it app, 5G and AI in customer experience as 2026 priorities. Entry points: SIPEN and the CNP Assises, Dec 18 to 19.
sum.fr: Sonatel et Orange Sénégal, la meilleure porte d'entrée commerciale : commandes vocales en wolof dans l'appli Max it, 5G et IA dans l'expérience client comme priorités 2026. Accès : SIPEN et Assises du CNP, 18 et 19 déc.

clashes.2026-12-12: **Saturday Dec 12 is the single biggest night of the window.** Golden Chic starts at 19:30 at The Ground in Diamniadio, about 30 km and 40 minutes from central Dakar, while Serge Beynaud (around 20:00, Grand Théâtre esplanade) and Obree Daman (20:30, Sorano) are both in the Plateau, a short taxi hop apart; the Outside Awards' second day is also at the Grand Théâtre, Dakar Court ends that day, FIDAK is in its first weekend, and the earlier guide's unsourced lead puts the ANPS sports awards on the same date. Golden Chic rules out everything else, so the couple should choose by mood: the dressy seated gala with Youssou N'Dour, or a Plateau night pairing a dinner with Obree Daman or the rowdier Beynaud party.
clashes.2026-12-13: **Sunday Dec 13** pits the Gris Bordeaux vs Diop 2 card in Pikine (usually afternoon into evening) against "Résonance" at Sorano at 18:00 and the reported last day of Partcours.
